name: Hairpins & Necklace
description: The sun and moon wonderland is full of beauty. There are "clouds and neon lights in the fairyland" that seem to be lingering; golden eaves and pavilions are like "trees and jade halls hanging"; "splendid comes to the fairyland" to express the graceful scenery. Pinku captures the dynamic beauty of fairyland, captures misty smoke and clouds in an instant, transforms fairy charm and flowers into the palm of your hand, and creates five ornaments of fairy-style oriental aesthetics.
